numerology_energy_guide.title: The Initiator
numerology_energy_guide.description: The 1 energy is physical and individual. It favors forward momentum and taking up space.

do.details: This energy needs a physical outlet. Push your limits, lift heavy, and sweat.
Point your drive at your goals. Play to win, in a business negotiation or a personal challenge.
A good day to launch a project, start a habit, or make the first move.
Claim your space. Say what you think clearly, hold your ground, and take charge.

avoid.details: The 1 is for beginnings, not endings. Closing a cycle today tends to meet resistance. Save endings for a 9 day.
The 1 runs hot. Don't let your competitive edge turn into anger or hostility.
There's a fine line between assertive and ruthless. Stay confident and keep your ego in check.
You're already stimulated on a 1 day. Alcohol adds volatility, lowers inhibitions, and feeds the aggressive traits you want to avoid.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Diplomat
numerology_energy_guide.description: The 2 energy is about sensitivity and cooperation. It heightens emotions, relationships, and intuition. People are more emotional than usual today, so tact and awareness matter.

do.details: The cooperative, sensitive tone of the 2 suits romantic dates and deepening partnerships.
Take your time and don't rush. Set up a comfortable environment to work in.
Let yourself feel your emotions, but keep them in check so they don't override your logic.
The 2 fits fluid, calming places. Spend time by the ocean, a lake, or a river to ground yourself.
Use the receptive energy of the day. Meditate, settle your mind, and listen to your gut.

avoid.details: This isn't a day for impulsive solo moves. Rushing will backfire.
With emotions heightened, misunderstandings are common. Don't jump to conclusions or judge people early.
Emotions are running high all around. Don't start conflicts, argue, or force issues. Keep the peace.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Creator
numerology_energy_guide.description: This energy amplifies communication, creativity, emotional release, visibility, and endings. People are more expressive, reactive, and emotionally open than usual today.

do.details: Brainstorm, write, speak, and make art. A good day to let ideas flow.
Go out and connect. Let your humor show; people are naturally drawn to you today.
Step outside your comfort zone. Say yes to unexpected invitations and see where they lead.

avoid.details: The 3 is highly creative, and tedious, routine work will be hard to push through. Save spreadsheets and heavy admin for tomorrow.
Don't hide or isolate. This is a day for visibility, and pulling back works against the energy.
Don't take things too seriously. Keep the mood light and don't let a scattered mind get in the way of enjoying the process.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Builder
numerology_energy_guide.description: Time to put the party away and get to work. The 4 energy is grounded and structural, and it asks for a lot of discipline.

do.details: Put your head down and work. This energy rewards plain effort.
Map out a plan, organize your workspace, and build solid systems for your future goals.
Stick to your routine. Tackle the tedious tasks you've been putting off and focus on your physical health.
Work through mental barriers and anxiety by taking practical action one step at a time.

avoid.details: The 4 is the number of law, order, and structure. Breaking rules, acting unethically, or doing anything illegal will backfire badly today.
Slacking off wastes this grounded energy. Put in the work.
Avoid gambling and uncalculated risks. Build your foundation brick by brick.
Pay close attention to details and rules.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Warrior and Adventurer
numerology_energy_guide.description: The 5 brings change, freedom, and unpredictable momentum. It's volatile: it can push you forward or pull you into chaos. The 5 is also a number of war and primal creation, so use it deliberately.

do.details: Fight for your goals, take on hard battles, and face opposition. If there's a conflict you need to win, engage today.
A strong day for sex with your wife. The vitality of the 5 makes it especially good for trying to conceive, if that has been difficult.
Move around, change your surroundings, and adapt to the unexpected. Say yes to spontaneous invitations and vary your routine.
The 5's visibility makes it a good day for public relations, sales, and getting your name out.

avoid.details: Avoid sex with anyone who isn't a partner. The 5's volatility makes reckless sex draining to your personal power.
Don't lock into long-term contracts or fixed schedules today. This energy needs flexibility.
Watch your spending, drinking, and eating. The 5 moves fast and makes excess easy.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Provider and Healer
numerology_energy_guide.description: The 6 brings the focus back to the heart, the home, and your community. It is a nurturing, responsible energy that asks for balance, service, and attention to your immediate surroundings.

do.details: Clean, organize, or beautify your living space, and repair what's broken. The state of your home directly affects your mental clarity today.
Spend quality time with family, your spouse, or close friends. Be dependable, offer sound advice, and show up for the people who rely on you.
Take care of your body. Eat clean, cooked meals, get a haircut, or update your wardrobe. The 6 is closely tied to aesthetics and self-preservation.
If there's tension in your household or relationship, this is the most supportive day for an open, honest conversation to restore harmony.
Give back in some small way. Help a neighbor, donate your time, or handle tasks that benefit the group rather than only yourself.

avoid.details: The trap of the 6 is the savior complex. Don't burn yourself out to keep others warm. Avoid overextending to the point of exhaustion.
The shadow side of the 6 is holding people to impossible standards. Avoid nagging your partner, micromanaging your kids, or judging others for their flaws.
Offer help if asked, but don't insert yourself into drama or situations where your advice wasn't requested.
Don't escape your duties by staying late at the office or avoiding home. Leaving chores, bills, or family issues unresolved today creates lingering stress.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Analyst and Seeker
numerology_energy_guide.description: The 7 energy calls for silence and inward focus. The physical and spiritual worlds overlap today, but your body is more vulnerable. It's a day for intellectual and spiritual growth, not outside noise.

do.details: Spend your hours taking in information. This is the best day of the cycle for deep research and absorbing complex ideas.
Choose solitude on purpose. Spend time in nature, reflect on your life path, and look for the deeper meaning in recent events.
Quiet your mind and trust your inner voice. The spiritual channel is open today, which makes it easier to reach genuine intuition.

avoid.details: Be careful: the 7 is physically fragile and your risk of injury is higher today. Skip extreme physical strain and avoid high-risk activities like skating, skiing, or racing cars.

avoid.action: Socializing with people you do not like
avoid.details: Protect your energy. Avoid shallow socializing and don't force time with people who drain you.
Stay sober. Your system is very sensitive today, and drugs will cloud the intellectual and spiritual clarity this day offers.
Don't chase material gain or put money into games of chance. The 7 runs on logic and spirit, not luck.
Your mind needs to process things internally. Hold off on major outward moves until the energy shifts tomorrow.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Executive
numerology_energy_guide.description: Power, business, and potential. The 8 works like a ledger: what you put into the world, financially and energetically, comes back to you.

do.details: Lead projects, ask for the raise, or close high-value deals. Step into your authority.
Balance your books. Settling what you owe clears the way for money to come back to you faster.
Review your long-term investments, scale your operations, and build toward your larger goals.
Wear your best clothes and walk into the room with presence.

avoid.details: Karma returns quickly on an 8 day. If you lie, cheat, or manipulate, it comes back harder, even if the consequences don't land today.
No under-the-table tactics. Act with integrity.

avoid.action: Letting fear keep you playing small
avoid.details: Don't back down from a challenge. The 8 is a high-power energy, and hesitating on your goals wastes its momentum.

numerology_energy_guide.title: The Closer
numerology_energy_guide.description: The cycle concludes. The 9 is the energy of completion and release. Today is for clearing out the old to make room for what's next, and for acting with compassion toward others.

do.action: End things you do not want in your life
do.details: The best day in the cycle to break bad habits, leave stagnant situations, or quit a dead-end job.
If a connection is draining you, finalize the breakup or set permanent boundaries today.
Donate money, clothes, or resources to someone or something in need. Do something selfless for the wider good.
Clean out your space, finish overdue tasks, forgive an old enemy, and let go of lingering emotional baggage.

avoid.details: Don't launch a company, start a new job, or begin a new project. Anything started under the 9 won't last long, because the energy pulls toward completion, not creation. Save launches for a 1 day.
Avoid clinging to old grudges or fighting the natural end of a cycle. If something or someone is leaving your life today, let them go without a struggle.
